# TorchEEG

> A Python library for EEG signal analysis with PyTorch.

TorchEEG provides datasets, signal transforms, data partitions, neural networks,
and trainers. Match all examples and APIs to the version in use. Unmerged
repository features are not part of a released package.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html): Dependencies and package installation.
- [Datasets](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.datasets.html): Dataset inputs, metadata and preprocessing.
- [Transforms](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.transforms.html): Signal and label transforms.
- [Partitions](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.model_selection.html): Subject, trial and sample splits.
- [Models](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.models.html): Model parameters and input shapes.
- [Trainers](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.trainers.html): Classification, regression and specialized training.
- [Examples](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/auto_examples/index.html): Runnable workflows and data requirements.
- [Agent guide](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent_guide.html): Using the repository guide and library skill.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg): Source code, tests and releases.
- [Contributor guide](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository layout and checks.
- [Library skill](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg/blob/main/.agents/skills/use-torcheeg/SKILL.md): EEG workflow instructions.

Use subject- or trial-based partitions when the protocol requires isolated groups.
Fit data-dependent preprocessing on training data only. A synthetic smoke test
does not establish EEG accuracy or reproduction of a published benchmark.
